{{Current events|year=2019|month=12|day=25|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)]]
**[[Taliban]] militants say they have [[kidnap]]ped 27 local [[peace activist]]s in [[Farah Province]] as they were traveling from [[Herat Province]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanitan-kidnapping/27-local-peace-activists-abducted-in-western-afghanistan-idUSKBN1YT0FB (Reuters)]
*[[Arbinda attack]]
**In [[Burkina Faso]], the [[Government of Burkina Faso|government]] orders 48 hours of [[mourning]] after the [[jihadist]] attack yesterday in [[Soum Province]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/mourning-burkina-faso-attack-kills-dozens-191225001927810.html (Al Jazeera)]
**A dozen [[Burkina Faso Armed Forces|Burkina Faso soldiers]] are killed in an armed attack in the night by militants responsible for the previous attack. [https://www.dw.com/en/burkina-faso-tense-in-mourning-amid-jihadist-attacks/a-51795594 (DW News)]
*Two "wanted [[terrorism in Saudi Arabia|terrorists]]" are killed in [[Dammam]], [[Saudi Arabia]], after exchanging gunfire with security forces. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-security/saudi-security-forces-kill-two-terrorists-after-dammam-city-shooting-tv-idUSKBN1YT0KU (Reuters)]
*[[Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] is briefly brought to a [[bomb shelter]] during an election rally in [[Ashkelon]], [[Israel]], after a rocket is fired from the [[Gaza Strip]]. The rocket is intercepted with no casualties reported. [https://www.nbcwashington.com/news/national-international/israel-gaza-rocket-intercepted-as-pm-held-election-rally/2192244/ (NBCWashington)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians-violence/gaza-rocket-sends-netanyahu-to-shelter-during-campaign-rally-tv-idUSKBN1YT0P6? (Reuters)]

;Arts and culture
*[[Notre-Dame de Paris fire]]
**[[Notre-Dame de Paris|Notre-Dame]] [[Rector (ecclesiastical)|rector]] Patrick Chauvet states there is "maybe a 50 percent chance that [the building] will be saved" due to deterioration of [[scaffolding]] near the vaults, and that renovations will not start until 2021 at the soonest. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/notre-dame-rector-fragile-cathedral-saved-191225163613989.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Law and crime
*[[Government of Japan|Japanese]] [[National Diet]] member [[Tsukasa Akimoto]] of the ruling [[Liberal Democratic Party (Japan)|Liberal Democratic Party]] is arrested for allegedly receiving up to [[Japanese yen|¥]]3 million in bribes from a [[China|Chinese]] company interested in setting up a [[casino]] in the country. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-japan-casino-corruption/japan-ruling-party-lawmaker-arrested-on-casino-bribery-suspicion-prosecutors-idUSKBN1YT03N?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Iraqi protests]]
**The largest [[Council of Representatives of Iraq|parlamentary]] [[bloc (politics)|bloc]], Binaa Bloc, including [[Fatah Alliance]] and [[State of Law Coalition]], nominates [[Basra Governorate|Basra]] governor [[Asaad Al Eidani]] to succeed [[Adil Abdul-Mahdi]] as [[Prime Minister of Iraq]]. Protesters reject the nomination, seeing him as part of the establishment. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/iraq-iran-backed-bloc-nominates-basra-governor-pm-191225124512897.html (Al Jazeera)]
